mutations.name: format characters are no longer stripped - the zero-width leak reopens
mutations.old: stripped = "".join(c for c in text if unicodedata.category(c) != "Cf")

mutations.name: NFKC normalisation dropped - full-width Latin walks through
the confusable map is never applied - the dotless i walks through
the separator class narrows back to AT-339's - plus and friends walk through (not the + form: unquote_plus makes that a space)
the fold stops composing with the variants (AT-346) - percent-escapes walk through
stripping happens AFTER normalising - order is load-bearing, not decorative
mutations.old:
stripped = "".join(c for c in text if unicodedata.category(c) != "Cf")
    normalised = unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", stripped).translate(ASCII_CONFUSABLES)
mutations.new:
normalised = unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", text).translate(ASCII_CONFUSABLES)
    normalised = "".join(c for c in normalised if unicodedata.category(c) != "Cf")
